clause.description: An optional branch scope plus exactly one condition. The oneOf below is what enforces `exactly one`: a clause naming two conditions matches two subschemas and fails, and a clause naming none matches zero and fails.

branch.description: A root task id. Omitted means the whole run.

tasks_resolved.description: No open task in scope can still be dispatched. `false` is not accepted: `stop while work remains` is what `research signal stop` is for.

min_hypothesis_confidence.description: Every non-refuted hypothesis in scope is at or above this. False when there are no hypotheses at all — vacuous truth here would stop a run before it formed a claim.

min_domains.description: Distinct registrable domains (eTLD+1) cited by active facts in scope. Same reduction as gate 3, so twelve pages of one blog count once.
